== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Overlords are powerful leaders who govern specific territories on behalf of the [[throne]]. They possess significant Authority{{!}}authority, commanding legions of soldiers, vast resources, and loyal supporters. Many Overlords are also experienced [[Travelers]] themselves, possessing years of combat and magical expertise that sets them apart from those with only recent training. Beyond their political roles, they are tasked with the critical responsibility of keeping the [[Incarnations]] imprisoned. Their territories are highly defended against land or magical approaches, making direct assaults on them very dangerous. Each Overlord is associated with a specific [[Tree]], and these are linked through Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus; nourishing one [[Tree]] provides nourishment to the others. Overlords also command various [[Travelers]] and personnel from different territories, such as [[Avernus]] or [[Naraka]], to carry out their orders. While some are known for being just and moral, others may use their power to arrest those who obstruct them. Their influence is widespread, often making them central figures in royal courts and regional stability.}}
